title: Model downloads
summary: useModelDownload() tracks and downloads on-demand models with progress; <ModelGate> asks before downloading and renders its children once the model is ready.
example:
import { ModelGate } from '@core/recipes/models'
<ModelGate download={vision.model} name="Qwen3-VL 2B" sizeBytes={1.6e9}>…</ModelGate>
